guides.title: What to do if you accidentally shared an OTP or password
guides.summary: Immediate emergency checklist to minimize financial and account loss if an OTP or credentials were compromised.
steps: Call your bank's emergency debit/credit card block helpline immediately.
Dial 1930 immediately to register a complaint with the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.
Change your NetBanking and UPI PINs from a secure device.
Log out of all active sessions in your Google, Apple, and banking accounts.

guides.title: How to spot a fake online shopping website in 60 seconds
guides.summary: Six tell-tale signs that an online store advertised on Instagram or Facebook is a counterfeit scam.
steps: Check prices: Premium electronics or apparel sold at 80% discount are almost always scams.
Payment check: If the site disables Cash on Delivery and only accepts UPI transfers to personal IDs, exit.
Domain inspection: Look for misspelled brand names and unusual extensions (.xyz, .shop, .top).
Contact verification: Check if a physical address, telephone number, and valid GSTIN are provided.

guides.title: Safe UPI Habits: Why receiving money NEVER requires a PIN
guides.summary: The single most critical rule of digital payments that prevents 90% of marketplace and refund fraud.
steps: Understand UPI architecture: PIN is required ONLY to debit your account, NEVER to credit it.
Decline collect requests: If you receive a popup requesting your PIN to get a refund or cashback, decline immediately.
Do not scan QR codes to receive money: QR codes are only for paying, never for accepting funds.

guides.title: Verifying unexpected callers claiming to be from banks or police
guides.summary: How to handle aggressive, threatening, or urgent phone calls without panicking.
steps: Never accept claims of 'Digital Arrest' — law enforcement in India never arrests or interrogates via phone.
Ask for their full name, designation, and official landline number, then hang up.
Independently dial the official customer care number listed on the back of your bank debit card.
Never download remote screen-sharing tools like AnyDesk or QuickSupport on instructions from a caller.

guides.title: How to secure your WhatsApp, Gmail, and banking apps
guides.summary: Simple, robust settings to protect your personal identity and messaging accounts from account takeovers.
steps: Enable Two-Step Verification (2FA) with a 6-digit PIN on WhatsApp.
Enable passkeys or authenticator apps on your Google and Apple accounts.
Set an alphanumeric screen lock on your smartphone and disable notification previews on the lock screen.
Regularly review 'Linked Devices' in WhatsApp settings to disconnect unauthorized sessions.

guides.title: Protecting elderly family members from digital fraud
guides.summary: Practical steps you can set up on parents' and grandparents' phones to protect them from high-pressure scammers.
steps: Install BaitCheck on their home screen for 1-tap scam checks before tapping unfamiliar links.
Set daily UPI transfer limits on their bank accounts to limit potential exposure.
Agree on a family safe-word for emergency money requests.
Encourage an open, no-shame environment: tell them never to act on urgent alerts without checking with family first.
